status: runtime-integrated presentation variants; server-assigned and replicated
creator: Project-local deterministic procedural generation
license: Original project work; no external asset dependencies
redistribution: May be redistributed with the project and game exports

contract.animation: MomentumLean changes exactly Pelvis, Spine, UpperArm.L, UpperArm.R, Thigh.L, and Thigh.R; Root transform does not change (constant exporter channels are permitted and Godot may remove them as immutable)
contract.source_semantics: Editable source retains 50 named rigid one-bone skinned semantic parts, including 14 graphite articulation interfaces
contract.runtime_geometry: Export-only consolidation produces seven skinned meshes, one per used material role, without changing triangles or skin weights
runtime_roles: Ceramic for Vector/STRATOS or Bronze for Khepri
contract.collision: No collision meshes or CollisionObject3D nodes
contract.team_geometry: One neutral geometry set per shell; red/blue are material overrides

variants.name: Vector Sprinter Mk II
variants.design: Narrow forward-canted wedge helmet and broad visor, V-taper relay torso, low swept shoulder and hip planes, long ski stabilizers, and depth-staggered horizontal twin ducts.

variants.name: STRATOS Foilframe
variants.design: Compact speed helmet and broad integrated team bib, uninterrupted aerofoil shoulder line, pinched waist, high vertical split-airbrake ducts, and strong calf stabilizers.

variants.name: Khepri Triune Salvage
variants.design: Faceted directional helmet, triune chest and hip contours, one asymmetric sensor vane, forked collar line, and depth/height-staggered lower bronze twin cowls.

known_limitations: Rigid skinning remains visibly hard-surface, while overlapping graphite interfaces maintain anatomical continuity.
MomentumLean is the only authored clip; locomotion state coverage is not production-complete.
Team-color area is an authored approximately 25 percent target, not a UV-area measurement.
Editable source remains 50 semantic parts while runtime exports are consolidated to seven material-role meshes.
Godot importer-generated LOD behavior is unchanged and has not been qualified as an authored character LOD strategy.
Off-screen red/blue review is complete at turntable and 96 px comparison scale; a human in-match readability playtest remains.
